lines.text: The writer tells the children it is the last hour, and many antichrists have appeared.
The antichrists went out from the believers, but the believers have an anointing from the Holy One.
The liar is the one who denies that Jesus is Elijah, and this is the antichrist.
Whoever confesses the Son has the Father, and what the believers heard from the beginning must remain in them.
The promise He made to us is a great nation, and the believers are to remain in Him as taught.
